1	# Proposal: visuals in the results (charts)
2	
3	**Status:** Proposed by Claude Code, 2026-10-18, for owner approval. Nothing here is built or added to the ACs yet.
4	**Requested by:** the owner ("add a few visuals, like charts"). The owner chose all four visuals.
5	
6	## Summary
7	
8	Four visuals, all inside the results card, all built from the schedule the app already computes:
9	
10	| # | Visual | Story | Role / job | What it answers |
11	|---|---|---|---|---|
12	| 1 | Cost split bar | **S-20** (new) | R-1 / J-2 | "How much of what I repay is interest?" |
13	| 2 | Balance over time | **S-21** (new) | R-3 / J-8 | "What will I still owe, and when?" |
14	| 3 | Payment make-up over time | **S-22** (new) | R-2 / J-5 | "Why does the interest part shrink?" |
15	| 4 | Yearly summary (chart + table) | **S-19** (Backlog → v1) | R-3 / J-9 | "How much interest did each year cost?" |
16	
17	**Order in the results card:**
18	1. the three figures and the rounding note (unchanged);
19	2. Cost breakdown;
20	3. Balance over time;
21	4. Interest and principal in each payment;
22	5. Yearly summary;
23	6. the Repayment schedule (unchanged, still last).
24	
25	## Rules every visual follows
26	
27	- **No new dependencies.** Each chart is hand-built inline SVG, drawn in React from the existing `CalculatedLoan`. There's no charting library and no network.
28	- **Never colour alone.** Each chart sits in a `<figure>` whose `<figcaption>` holds a one-sentence text summary (exact wording below). The data is also always available as a table: the existing schedule, plus a new yearly table. The SVG itself is `aria-hidden="true"`, because the figcaption and the tables carry the information for assistive technology.
29	- **Legends:** charts with two series (principal and interest) show an HTML legend, plus direct labels where they fit. One-series charts have no legend; the title names the series.
30	- **Colour:** two categorical series in a fixed order, Principal first and Interest second, the same in every chart. The pairs are checked with the data-visualisation validator script against the light and dark surfaces, not by eye. The marks may need deeper shades than the pastel fills to reach 3:1 against the surface (WCAG 1.4.11). Text uses text tokens only.
31	- **One axis per chart,** no dual axes. Axes and grid are kept quiet.
32	- **Hover:** a tooltip on the balance, payment and yearly charts (crosshair or per-bar) showing the exact values. Keyboard and screen-reader users get the same values from the tables.
33	- **Performance:** each series is a single SVG `<path>`, never 1,200 elements, so L-MAX (1,200 months) keeps AC-10.8's 1-second budget.
34	- **Layout:** fluid width with no fixed pixel sizes, so there's no horizontal page scroll from 180 px up; works in both themes.
35	
36	## New domain functions (pure, unit-tested)
37	
38	- `costSplit(loan): { interestPercent: Decimal, loanPercent: Decimal }`
39	  - `interestPercent = round1(100 × totalInterest / totalPayable)`, where `round1` rounds half-up to 1 dp;
40	  - `loanPercent = 100 − interestPercent`, so the two always sum to exactly 100.0.
41	- `yearlySummary(loan): { year, months, interest, principal, balance }[]`
42	  - groups of 12 schedule rows, with a shorter final group when the tenure isn't a whole number of years;
43	  - sums are exact `Decimal`s;
44	  - `balance` is the balance after the group's last month.
45	- `formatPercent(x: Decimal): string`: always 1 dp, for example `6.2%` or `0.0%`.
46

365	Breakpoints: **≥ 769 px**: the form and results cards side by side (form roughly 40%, results roughly 60%) with Saved calculations full-width below; max content width 1200 px. **≤ 768 px**: a single column in DOM order. 367	### 8.2 Schedule table
368	
369	A semantic `<table>` with `<thead>` and `<th scope="col">`, inside a wrapper with `role="region"`, `aria-label` = `schedule.title`, `tabindex="0"`, `overflow: auto` and `max-height: min(60vh, 480px)`. 372	
373	- Each error renders in an element with an id. The input gets `aria-invalid="true"` and `aria-describedby` pointing to it, and the error text sits in an `aria-live="polite"` container.

375	- **Confirm dialog:** native `<dialog>` opened with `showModal()`. Focus targets are set **explicitly in code**, not with React's `autoFocus` (which fires at mount, not at `showModal()`) and not left to the browser's return-focus (macOS Safari and Firefox don't focus buttons on click). After `showModal()`, focus **Cancel**. **Cancel** or Escape (the `cancel` event) closes it without action and focuses **Clear all**. **Clear** clears the history and focuses the **Saved calculations** heading, because **Clear all** is now disabled (D-30). `aria-labelledby` points to the `dialog.clear.text` element and `aria-describedby` to `dialog.clear.hint`. **No JS focus trap** (D-20): Tab may leave the dialog to the browser's own UI, but must never reach page content behind the dialog (AC-8.5).
